meta.title: Convolvex-MS workbench
meta.description: Opens the Convolvex-MS mass-spectrometry workbench from the left sidebar using the original web UI. Pick a DSH workspace at the top of the panel; datasets, run records and project files are stored under that workspace's .convolvex-ms directory. The convolvex_workbench agent tool reads run records from the same workspace. Numerical analysis reuses the original Convolvex service and solvers, and the background service stops when the plugin unloads.
